description: Starts a Seedance 2.5 video from a recipe; debits credits up to max_credits. When to use: after estimate_cost with template_slug set to the recipe slug and the same settings. image_to_video recipes need a start image (upload id, image generation id, or https URL) and may take an end image. Omitted settings and prompt use the recipe defaults.

end_image_generation_id.description: Optional end image from a Vidaro image generation id.

prompt.description: Optional prompt override (recipe default if omitted).
prompt.title: Prompt

start_image_generation_id.description: Start image from a Vidaro image generation id.
